headline: H100 SXM and H200 rental indexes fall sharply over 7 days while other GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index fell -19% over 7 days to $4.32, and H200's fell -18% to $5.40.
B200, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were unchanged at +0% over 7 days, with B200's market index at $8.50.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 versus a neocloud median of $4.07.
MI300X is the best price-performance GPU at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, and its cheapest provider, RunPod Community Cloud, lists a median of $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour, despite a market index of only $2.70.
watch: Watch whether the -19% H100 SXM and -18% H200 declines spread to B200, whose index has held at +0%.
